name: radio
summary: Picks one option of a few, named by its field, the ring and its words one control: the arrow keys move the choice and pass a disabled option, with read-only, disabled, required and invalid.

notCovered.name: ui-radio-indicator
notCovered.why: The dot is drawn in the radio's own ::before with its ring, so the check reads ring and dot as one graphic; the stage holds no indicator, so neither its starting nor its ending style is shown.

notCovered.name: the touch target
notCovered.why: Under a coarse pointer UI SDK lays an empty box over each radio, at least 2.75rem each way, so a tap near it reaches it. It draws nothing, so no light reads it; at phone width the radio itself is 2.75rem tall, so there the box is the radio's own size.
